module: Shows a comic (sequence of panels) in the campaign interface. playComic builds the list of panels from comicData then opens the UI screen "campaign.comic"; when the Spine animation is finished, the provided callback is called. The GUI audio channel is played during the display.
notes: comicData: {path = folder, order = list, backgroundSound = ...}. Each entry of order is either a string (panel name) or a table {comic = name, sound = ...}. Each panel becomes "path/name/".
The code that muted the other audio channels is commented out ("buggy"), but reset() still restores lastVolumes if it is set; in practice lastVolumes stays empty.
If comicData is nil, playComic returns without showing anything and without calling the callback.

playComic.desc: Prepares the panels, starts the AudioChannelGui audio channel and navigates to the "campaign.comic" screen with the list of panels. Stores the end callback.

comicData.desc: Description of the comic: path, order, backgroundSound.

comicFinishedCallback.desc: Called once the comic is finished; nop if absent.

onSpineAnimationFinished.desc: Hook called by the interface at the end of the Spine animation: runs the stored callback (only once), restores the volumes and stops the AudioChannelGui channel (stop with parameter 1).

onScenarioChange.desc: Scenario change hook: if sc is nil or its state is "pre-start", restores the stored audio volumes.

sc.desc: Current scenario; its state field is read.
